note: Manual reclaim with the GPU's warning window (default its warningWindowSeconds; override with warningSeconds). Same code path as provider reclaims: reclaim(gpuId, warningSeconds, reason). The router stops admitting work there immediately; every job on it checkpoints inside the warning window and continues on the best other GPU (any provider) for its order's mode. The GPU returns after durationSeconds. Guaranteed on-demand capacity cannot be reclaimed; a Moonshift GPU reclaim models an incoming booking. Requires X-MS-Internal-Key when INTERNAL_API_KEY is set.

errors.NOT_INTERRUPTIBLE: 409, guaranteed on-demand capacity cannot be reclaimed
